Name: StationSummary
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: StationSummary, command: many)
SELECT
    station,
    any_value(tally) AS any_tally,
    arbitrary(reading) AS arbitrary_reading,
    first(reading ORDER BY taken_at) AS opening_reading,
    last(taken_at) AS last_taken_at,
    arg_min(id, taken_at) AS earliest_id,
    arg_max(station, reading) AS peak_station,
    argmax(tally, reading) AS peak_tally,
    min_by(price, reading) AS cheapest_price,
    max_by(taken_on, tally) AS busiest_day,
    arg_max(id, reading, 3) AS top_ids,
    product(reading) AS reading_product,
    fsum(reading) AS reading_total,
    favg(reading) AS reading_average,
    mean(price) AS mean_price,
    kurtosis(reading) AS reading_kurtosis,
    skewness(reading) AS reading_skewness,
    entropy(tally) AS tally_entropy,
    sem(reading) AS reading_error,
    approx_count_distinct(id) AS distinct_ids,
    approx_quantile(tally, 0.5) AS approximate_median_tally,
    reservoir_quantile(reading, 0.9) AS sampled_reading,
    quantile(tally, 0.5) AS median_tally,
    quantile_cont(reading, 0.5) AS median_reading,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reading) AS percentile_reading,
    histogram(tally) AS tally_histogram,
    approx_top_k(station, 2) AS frequent_stations,
    corr(reading, tally) AS correlation,
    covar_pop(reading, tally) AS population_covariance,
    covar_samp(reading, tally) AS sample_covariance,
    regr_slope(reading, tally) AS slope,
    regr_intercept(reading, tally) AS intercept,
    regr_r2(reading, tally) AS fit,
    regr_count(reading, tally) AS fitted_rows,
    count_if(valid) AS valid_readings,
    count_star() AS readings,
    group_concat(station, ',') AS stations,
    listagg(station) AS listed_stations,
    string_agg(tally, ',') AS tallies,
    geomean(reading) AS geometric_mean,
    weighted_avg(reading, tally) AS weighted_reading
FROM readings
GROUP BY station;

Name: ReadingCalendar
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: ReadingCalendar, command: many)
SELECT
    id,
    year(taken_at) AS taken_year,
    month(taken_on) AS taken_month,
    day(taken_on) AS taken_day,
    hour(taken_at) AS taken_hour,
    minute(taken_at) AS taken_minute,
    second(taken_at) AS taken_second,
    millisecond(taken_at) AS taken_millisecond,
    quarter(taken_on) AS taken_quarter,
    week(taken_on) AS taken_week,
    weekday(taken_on) AS taken_weekday,
    dayofweek(taken_on) AS taken_day_of_week,
    dayofyear(taken_at) AS taken_day_of_year,
    isodow(taken_on) AS taken_iso_day,
    epoch(taken_at) AS taken_epoch,
    epoch_ms(taken_at) AS taken_epoch_ms,
    date_diff('day', taken_on, current_date) AS age_days,
    datediff('hour', taken_at, now()) AS age_hours,
    date_sub('month', taken_on, current_date) AS age_months,
    datepart('year', taken_at) AS taken_part,
    datetrunc('month', taken_at) AS taken_month_start,
    date_add(taken_on, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS next_day,
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', taken_at) AS hour_bucket,
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '7 days', taken_on) AS week_bucket,
    to_days(tally) AS tally_days,
    to_hours(tally) AS tally_hours,
    try_strptime(payload, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_payload,
    transaction_timestamp() AS started_at,
    date_diff('day', taken_on, DATE '2024-12-31') AS days_left,
    TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS epoch_start
FROM readings
WHERE taken_at > '2024-01-01'
  AND taken_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31';

Name: ReadingValues
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: ReadingValues, command: many)
SELECT
    id,
    string_split(payload, ',') AS payload_parts,
    str_split(station, '-') AS station_parts,
    split(station, '-') AS split_station,
    regexp_split_to_array(payload, '[,;]') AS payload_fields,
    regexp_extract_all(payload, '[0-9]+') AS payload_numbers,
    lcase(station) AS lower_station,
    ucase(station) AS upper_station,
    sha256(station) AS station_digest,
    hex(station) AS station_hex,
    levenshtein(station, payload) AS edit_distance,
    jaro_winkler_similarity(station, payload) AS similarity,
    jaccard(station, payload) AS overlap,
    strip_accents(station) AS plain_station,
    url_encode(station) AS encoded_station,
    format_bytes(tally) AS tally_size,
    list_has(scores, 3) AS has_three,
    list_has_any(tags, ['a', 'b']) AS has_any_tag,
    list_concat(scores, [1, 2]) AS more_scores,
    list_slice(tags, 1, 2) AS first_tags,
    list_position(tags, 'a') AS tag_position,
    list_intersect(scores, [1, 2]) AS common_scores,
    list_reverse(tags) AS reversed_tags,
    list_append(scores, tally) AS appended_scores,
    list_prepend(tally, scores) AS prepended_scores,
    list_select(tags, [1]) AS selected_tags,
    list_where(scores, [true, false]) AS masked_scores,
    list_grade_up(scores) AS score_order,
    list_sum(scores) AS score_total,
    list_avg(scores) AS score_average,
    list_min(scores) AS lowest_score,
    list_max(tags) AS last_tag,
    list_count(scores) AS score_count,
    list_first(tags) AS first_tag,
    list_string_agg(tags) AS joined_tags,
    list_cosine_similarity([1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 1.0]) AS cosine,
    sqrt(0.5) AS root_half,
    fmod(reading, 2) AS reading_remainder,
    fdiv(tally, 3) AS tally_third,
    tanh(reading) AS reading_tanh,
    signbit(reading) AS negative_reading,
    round_even(reading, 1) AS rounded_reading,
    greatest_common_divisor(tally, 12) AS common_divisor,
    xor(tally, 1) AS flipped_tally,
    json_extract(payload, '$.a') AS payload_a,
    json_extract_string(payload, '$.a') AS payload_a_text,
    json_exists(document, '$.a') AS has_a,
    json_value(document, '$.a') AS document_a,
    json_extract_path_text(document, '$.a') AS document_a_text,
    json(payload) AS payload_document,
    lower(document) AS lower_document,
    length(document) AS document_length,
    uuidv7() AS request_id
FROM readings;
